Title: Generally Available: New versions supported for languages and frameworks in Azure App Service

Body.Content: Azure App Service is regularly updated to provide new runtime versions to allow web app developers to take advantage of the latest runtime features and security fixes. We are now adding support for Python 3.10, PHP 8.1 and Node 18, giving them a choice of more versions of the latest and fastest growing web app development languages available.
